ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels exceeding 90% of visible surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at distal tips and notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white patch localized at the right distal tip; smaller irregular white cluster at left distal tip; distinct linear white mark located at the center-left adjacent to the median notch; sparse, circular white mottling across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire continuous boundary; irregular jaggedness with peaks and valleys varying between 5-15 pixels in depth from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer trailing edges exhibit a consistent convex curve sweeping from the notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected circular white clusters consistent with barnacle scarring on the lower-left ventral surface and the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white diagonal linear disruption (~50 pixels) located left of the median notch; multiple faint, parallel horizontal rake marks visible on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white scarring at the right lobe tip; significant unaligned white mark adjacent to the central notch; irregular micro-notches along trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of right-tip white pigmentation and a high-contrast central linear mark.
